checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and radare2 both recover one function at 0x004C6760 with 3 blocks and 3 edges; angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate Terrain_CreateTileMap is at 0x00458710 in igi1.exe 35d92a3a; its current compiled body was re-reviewed because the 0x00C30080 table moved from .data to .bss and the loop gained an alignment jump.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail is cdecl with the context at [esp+4] and the script-argument pointer at [esp+8]; Binary Ninja's 'float arg2' is a pointer typing artifact. The candidate declares void*(void* context, const float* args) in the same order.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail computes (Script_EvalArgInt(args,0) << 6) + 0x00C30080 and stores 0x40 bytes from argument indices 1..0x40. The candidate uses the same <<6 stride, 64-byte table and 0x40-byte loop; it additionally clamps the group index into 0..63.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail stores each Script_EvalArgInt result byte at table+i (i = 0..0x3F) and copies a 0x18-byte context block with the 0x00567C74 descriptor at +0x10; the candidate writes the same bytes/offsets. Deviations: out-of-range group indices are clamped to entry 0 (retail has no bounds check) and the uninitialized context dwords are zeroed; both are recorded.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls Script_EvalArgInt once per table byte; the candidate reads the same argument slots through its inline Script_GetArg helper. The differential harness hooks the retail accessor and supplies the same values, so the byte-store sequence is compared directly.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail returns arg1 after the context copy; the candidate returns context and adds a host-only null-args guard returning the same pointer. No retail error path exists.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither body performs arithmetic on floating-point values; the candidate truncates each accessor result to char exactly as the retail byte store does. The differential compares the resulting 64-byte records and passed 8/8.
